title: Outstanding Balance
text: Outstanding balance is the synthetic principal exposure remaining on active loan accounts.

title: DPD 30
text: DPD 30 identifies a synthetic account that is at least 30 days past its scheduled due date.

title: Delinquency Rate
text: Delinquency rate is the number of accounts with DPD of at least 30 divided by the number of accounts in the selected portfolio.

title: Approval Rate
text: Approval rate is approved synthetic applications divided by all decided synthetic applications in the selected period.

title: Portfolio Review
text: Portfolio review means analytical review of aggregate synthetic trends. It is not an individual lending decision.
